Name: Match Ports
Description: UDP ports 9002-9020, one per match this node is hosting. Listening while at least one runs; Not Listening when the node is idle, which is normal. Forward these to this machine. Must match udp_port_range in control-server.json.

Name: Master Link
Description: Green while this node is connected to its master, red when it isn't. A status-only listener on 127.0.0.1, opened by the amp-master-link.sh start-up step. Don't forward it.
